partnershipPlan: The patient advisory group and a community organisation for patients who write in other languages review the portal notice and the plain-language summary.
socialListening: No social media listening; complaints about portal response times are summarised in anonymised form.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I wrote that my chest felt tight and got a reply the next afternoon.
items.implication: Report what the flag would have done with urgent messages that waited.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Tell me how many urgent messages it misses before you ask me to ignore the rest.
items.implication: Lead with sensitivity and the missed messages.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I write for my father; I put everything in one message so nothing gets lost.
items.implication: Report accuracy for multi-request and carer messages.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Our members write in their own language because that is how they can explain the problem.
items.implication: Add clinic C when it resumes so the language subgroup can be estimated.

summary: Four composite voices on waiting, trust, carers and language.
